title: Aurum Alpha collection envelope
description: The cursor-paginated collection response. Governed by standards/050-http.md HA3. schemaVersion 1 — evolves additively per PC6.

cursor.description: Opaque to every consumer (HA3, and 020-identifiers.md IP3 for the same reason ids are opaque): the server generates it, the client echoes it, nobody parses it. A client that decodes a cursor has coupled itself to a query plan.

collection.description: A page of a collection. next_cursor null means the end, unambiguously; an empty data array with a non-null cursor is legal, because filtering can empty a page.

data.description: The page's items. Empty is legal and does not imply the end.

next_cursor.description: The cursor for the next page, or null at the end.
